book.name: Yohannisa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Yohannisi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusanne Niqodimoosa
Farsaaweta bagga as Ayhudata halaqatappe issi Niqodimoosa geetettiza asi dees.

Izi qamara Yesusaakko biidi, «Astamaaree! Xoossi izara dizaade gidikkofe attiin hayta ne ooththiza malalisiza malaatata ooththana dandayzaadey deenna; hessa gishshas neni Xoossa achchafe yida astamaare gididayssa nu eroos» gides.
Yesusikka izas zaaridi, «Ta nees tumu gays; asi nam7anththo yelettontta aggiko Xoossa kawoteth beyanaas dandayenna» gides.
Niqodimoosikka zaaridi, «Histtiin asi cimmidaappe guye waanidi nam7anththo yelettana dandayzee? Qasseka ba aayi ulon simmi gelidi yelettanee?» giidi oychchides.
Yesusikka izas, «Ta nees tumu gays; asi haaththafenne Xillo Ayanappe yelettontta dishe Xoossa kawoteth gelanaas dandayenna.
Asappe yelettiday asa; Ayanappe yelettiday Ayana.
Hessa gishshas, ‹Intte nam7anththo yelettanaas koshshees› ta nena gida gishshas malalettofa.
Carkoy ba koyida bagga carkees; neni carkos giiris siyaasa attiin izi awappe yizaakkonne awa bizaakko erakka. Ayanappe yelettidaykka hessa mala» gides.
Niqodimoosi, «Hayssi waani hanana dandayzee?» giidi oychchides.
Yesusikka izas, «Isra7eele astamaare gida uttada hessa ne erkkii?
Ta nees tumu gays; nuni nu erizayssa yootoos. Nu be7idayssa markkattoos; gido attiin intte nu markkateth ekkeketa.
Ta inttes hayssa ha biitta yo7o yootiin ammanontta ixxiko salo miish yootikko wostti intte ammananee?
Saloppe duge wodhdhida asa Naappe attiin pude salo keziday haray oonikka deenna.
«Bazzo biittan Musey shoosh dhoqqu histti kaqqidayssaththo hessaththoka Asa Nay dhoqqasohon kaqettanaas bessees.
Hessika izan ammanizaadey wurikka mernaa de7o demmanaassa.
Xoossa Naa ammanizay wuri mernaa de7o demmanaappe attiin dhayontta mala Xoossi hayssa alameza daro siiqida gishshas ba mexi issi naaza immides.
Xoossi ba naaza duge alame kiittiday alame asay izan ammanidi attana malassa attiin izi alame asaa bolla pirdanaas gidenna.
«Iza ammanizaade bolla pirdettenna. Iza ammanonttaadey gidikko Xoossa Naa issinezan ammanontta gishshas kasekka pirdetti uttides.
Pirdayka hayssa mala, poo7oy ha alame yides shin asaas oosoy iita gidida gishshas asay poo7oppe keehi dhuma dosides.
Iita ooththizaadey wurikka poo7o dosenna. Izi ooththiza iita oosoy qoncce kezontta mala izi ba hu7es poo7oy dizaso kezenna.
Tumu ooththizaadey gidikko poo7oy dizaso yees. Izi poo7oy dizaso yiza gaasoykka Xoossa azazo mala izi ooththida oosoy qonccana malassa» gides.
Yesusanne Xammaqiza Yohannisa
Hessafe guye Yesusi bana kaallizaytara Yuhuda dere bides; heenkka asaa xammaqishe isttara guuththa wode gam7ides.
He wode Saalime achchan Henoone geetettizason daro Haaththi diza gishshas Yohannisi asaa xammaqishin asaykka izakko biidi xammaqettides.
He wode Yohannisi buro qasho keeththe gelibeenna.
He wode Yohannisa kaallizayta giddoninne issi issi Ayhuda asata giddon Ayhudata geesho wogaa gishshas gita palamay dendides.
Yohannisa kaallizayti izakko shiiqidi, «Astamaaree! Nenara Yordaanoose shaafa pinththan issife dishin ne iza gishshas markkatto addezi hekko xammaqees; asaykka izakko bees» gida.
Yohannisikka isttas, «Oonaska Xoossafe imettontta dishin aykkoyka daana dandayenna.
«Tani izappe sinththata kiitettadis attiin yaana gida Kirstoosi tana gidikke» gaada ta inttes yootoyssas intte intte hu7era ta markkatta.

Sarge wode ekkana mishiray dizaadey izikka mishira; mishira laggey gidikko mishiraza achchan eqqidi mishirazi gizaaz siyees; mishiraza qaala siyidi ufayettees; hessa gishshas ta ufayssi ha7i polettides.
Izi dhoqqu dhoqqu gaana mala tanikka ziqqi ziqqi gaana koshshees.
«Bollafe yizaadey ubbaafe bolla; garsa biittafe yizaadey izi biittafenne biittaaz yootees; Saloppe yizaadey izi ubbaafe bolla.
Izi ba be7idaazinne ba siyidaaz markkattees; gido attiin iza markkateth ekkizaadey deenna.
Iza markkateth ekkizaadey gidikko Xoossa tumanchcha gididayssa qonccisees.
Xoossi kiittidaadey Xoossa qaala yootees. Xoossika izaades ba Ayana makki immenna.
«Aaway ba naa dosees. Haniza yo7o ubbaa iza kushen aaththi immees.
Naazan ammanizaades mernaa de7oy dees. Naazan ammanonttay gidikko Xoossa hanqoy iza bolla daana attiin de7o demmenna» gides.
